99 old amboy rd|08857.summary: 99 Bridge residents praise the well-maintained building, spacious apartments with high ceilings, and extensive amenities including pool, BBQ grills, fitness center, and dog park. Staff members Joe, Susie, and Jess receive exceptional reviews for responsiveness and friendliness. The convenient location near major routes is highlighted.

reviews.name: Neal Udsen
reviews.body: Though this is my partner and I’s first apartment together, we strongly believe we are extremely lucky to be living at 99 bridge. All of the public spaces are maintained regularly and we are grateful to Joe and the maintenance team for that. Joe and the maintenance team are always so kind and go above and beyond to ensure that everyone is taken care of. It’s obligatory to mention that Joe has great taste in music which we hear over the speakers by the pool in the summer. We can’t rate the community higher than five stars and thanks for all that you guys do to make the community feel welcoming.

response.body: Thank you so much for your kind words, Neal! It is very rewarding to hear that you and your partner have had such a positive experience living at 99 Bridge in Old Bridge. We appreciate your recognition of Joe and the maintenance team for their hard work and dedication to making the community feel welcoming. We are glad that you have enjoyed the music playing by the pool in the summer. We will continue to strive to provide the best experience for all of our residents. Thank you for your five-star rating and for your recommendation of our services.

reviews.name: Joe Gilbert
reviews.body: I have lived at 99 bridge for 2 years now and my experience has been great, Joe and susie do a great job managing the building and keeping it in top shape. When you put in a request for maintenance Joe is either there that day or early the next day to fix the issue. The building is beautiful but the staff makes it that much better.

response.body:
Dear Joe, 

Thank you so much for your kind words about 99 Bridge, located in Old Bridge. We are so glad to hear that you have had a great experience living here for the past two years. 

We are also glad to hear that you have had positive experiences with our staff, Joe and Susie. We strive to provide the best service possible, and it is wonderful to hear that you have experienced that first hand. 

Thank you for taking the time to write a review and for your loyalty. We hope to continue to provide the same level of service and satisfaction for years to come. 

Sincerely,
The 99 Bridge Team

reviews.name: Amani Copes-Dennis
reviews.body: Next week marks my first month living here and all I can say is WOW! Coming from someone who lived in the Bronx in a small space, this is a tremendous upgrade. All of the amenities, appearance, and just the community aspect of the complex are nothing short of outstanding! I love the spacious units, friendly neighbors, modern appliances and this is a place that I can truly call my home. The swimming pool, outdoor grilling, Amazon Lockers, Outdoor Patio, Dog Park, EV charging, fitness center are some of the amazing amenities just to name a few. It is located right on route 9 or 18 so it is so easy to run errands, find local shops , and is less than 30 min away from Newark Airport. Most importantly, management is always on top of everything in regard to repairs, questions, and every portion of the building is cleaned daily. Do not hesitate to put in that application and ask for Susie! As the property manager, she makes it her best effort to make everyone feel welcome and appreciated!

response.body:
Dear Amani, 

Thank you for your glowing review of 99 Bridge! We are delighted to hear that you love the spacious units, friendly neighbors, modern appliances and amenities like the swimming pool, outdoor grilling, Amazon Lockers, Outdoor Patio, Dog Park, EV charging, and fitness center. It's great that you can easily run errands and find local shops, and that you are less than 30 minutes away from Newark Airport. We are especially pleased to hear that you appreciate our property manager, Susie, who works hard to make sure everyone feels welcome and appreciated. 

We are so glad that 99 Bridge is your new home and thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We look forward to continuing to provide you with an excellent living experience. 

Sincerely, 
The 99 Bridge Team

reviews.name: Yishai Friedman
reviews.body:
99 bridge is a safe and warm environment where luxury meets convenience.
Their amenities/lounge/lobby (too many to list 🤪) is always looking spiff and immaculate.

They’re conveniently located near EVERYTHING, you name it it’s within 5 minutes.

The people here are so nice and loving, like one happy family.

Oh and before I forget, the staff  at this place is 2nd to none. We got Joe in maintenance, just a wonderful person, and a gentleman. (I wonder what he does all day, the building is always functional 🤷) we got santos who keeps the place as polished as you see it. And finally we have Jess, Jess goes above and beyond to make sure that everything is as seamless as possible, and treats each person with high regard and importance. We all feel lucky to have her as our building manager #jessforpresident2024

In short “you may have 99 problems but a (99) BRIDGE ain’t one”

response.body:
Hello Yishai,

Thank you so much for your incredibly positive and heartwarming review! We are thrilled to hear that 99 Bridge has become a safe and warm haven for you, where luxury seamlessly meets convenience.
It's delightful to know that our amenities, lounge, and lobby have left a lasting impression on you. We take great pride in maintaining an immaculate environment for our residents, and it's wonderful to hear that it's appreciated.

reviews.name: JW Sankie
reviews.body:
So after living here for a few months I  have to give an honest review of 99 living & its staff. To start 99 is a wonderful up to date building with even more beautiful apartments. People here seem to be friendly. For the most part people seem to mind their business which is great as my wife and I enjoy minding our own lol . Very dog friendly place. Very lucky that the neighboring  apartments are occupied by nice people .
The manager Jess is such a cool Woman , very accommodating and also very kind to all dogs as she does keep treats for them . She is just always friendly and doesn’t just treat you as a resident .   Many places will have maintenance trouble rite ? That’s expected everywhere . Except here at 99 because we have JOE !!! Any work needed to be done it’s done correct ! & fast ! This man is very smart, hardworking and it shows .  just genuinely a good person . Just a wonderful and pleasant experience from every encounter I’ve had with him  . I told him before he reminds me of Superman , they look alike too . Ohhhh and when the pools open them grills are going and Everybody Eats !!!!!!!!!!!. It’s a nice community here .

response.body:
Hello JW,
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughts and experiences with us! We're thrilled to hear that you're enjoying your time at 99 Living and that our team have made such a positive impression on you! Creating a welcoming and accommodating environment is always our goal, so we're glad to hear that you've found the building and its residents to be friendly and respectful.

reviews.name: Victoria Okonek
reviews.body: 99 Bridge has been such a wonderful experience thus far. Susie is THE best and the whole building is so lucky to have her! She makes moving (which is such a chore) easy and pleasurable. Not an easy task! Apartments are well kept, building is always clean (Joe and Robert are also wonderful). I highly recommend!

response.body:
Dear Victoria, 

Thank you so much for your kind words about 99 Bridge in Old Bridge. We are so glad you are enjoying your experience with us and that you appreciate Susie and her efforts to make the moving process easier. We are also pleased that you are enjoying the well-kept apartments and the cleanliness of the building. Joe and Robert are great assets to our team and we appreciate your recognition of their hard work. 

We hope you continue to have a wonderful experience with us. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you, 
99 Bridge

reviews.name: Megan Odell
reviews.body: Joe the maintenance man was amazing and very helpful with fixing my AC outside of regular hours. I appreciate his promptness!

response.body:
Hello Megan,
Ensuring our residents' comfort and satisfaction is our top priority, and it's great to know that Joe's efforts have made a positive impact on your experience!

reviews.name: Joe McGeehan
reviews.body: Charming community with wonderful amenities. The pool and BBQ grills with outside TVs make for family fun in the summer. The courtyard fire pits on a cool autumn night are so peaceful and relaxing. The lounge with the pool/shuffle board table and big TVs are perfect for game night. Apartments are big an spacious with high ceilings. All GE appliances which are best of the best. A dog run on site for the pups. Happy to be here.

response.body:
Dear Joe,
Thank you for taking the time to share your wonderful experience at 99 Bridge in Old Bridge. We are delighted to hear that you have enjoyed the amenities and services we have to offer. Our pool and BBQ grills with outside TVs are perfect for family fun in the summer. The courtyard fire pits on a cool autumn night are so peaceful and relaxing. The lounge with the pool/shuffle board table and big TVs are great for game night. We are also glad that you have been pleased with the size and quality of our apartments. We strive to provide the best GE appliances and a safe and secure dog run for your pup. We are glad that you are happy here at 99 Bridge. 

Warm Regards, 
99 Bridge Management Team

They have been there every step of the way to insure you receive nothing but the best throughout the entire process. The perk of being able to walk out of your apartment and being steps away from multiple eateries, botiques, fitness and spa business’ as well as a grocery store is superb! As well as being so close to the beautiful downtown Princeton. I would highly  recommend to anyone looking to move to Princeton to check Avalon Princeton on Harrison. The gorgeous property, the prime location, and the AMAZING team are all top-notch!!!

reviews.body: From start to finish the property management staff (Brian in particular!) have been more than accommodating and beyond helpful making my first renting experience an amazing journey. I am grateful to the entire staff!

reviews.body:

Brian provided me with multiple leasing options in this brand-new, inspiring community. I had the opportunity to visit Avalon Harrison, and it is truly striking. Brian's positive attitude and customer-focused nature are evident in his interactions, making the leasing process seamless. I was deeply impressed by his responsiveness and willingness to assist at every step. If you're looking to rent in the Princeton area, Avalon Harrison is a fantastic choice, and Brian will ensure your experience is both smooth and memorable.

response.body: Glad to hear Brian’s dedication to making the leasing process seamless stood out to you, M. It’s great to know he made the experience smooth and informative for you!

reviews.name: Nicole
reviews.body: We’ve been touring multiple places in the area and by far the Avalon properties have been the best we’ve seen. They are maintained very well and feel more trustworthy of a place to rent from. The staff we’ve interacted with have been warm, welcoming, and professional. 22 robeson st|08876.summary: Avalon Somerville Station receives praise for exceptional staff service, particularly Nancy Jones and Brittney Ramsey who provide welcoming, professional support. Tenants love the luxury amenities including pool, gym, and event lounge, plus unbeatable downtown location. The property is consistently described as gorgeous, clean, and well-maintained with responsive maintenance staff like Eddie.

reviews.name: Paloma Sande
reviews.body: Eddie is always prompt, courteous, and professional whenever I have a maintenance issue. Eddie goes above and beyond to make sure that everything is fixed correctly and in a timely manner. I truly appreciate his attention to detail and the care he puts into his work. I feel lucky to have someone like Eddie taking care of the maintenance at my apartment complex. Thank you, Eddie, for all that you do!

response.body: Eddie’s promptness and dedication to his work are exactly what we strive for in our maintenance team. We're pleased to hear that his attention to detail and professionalism have made you feel well taken care of, Paloma! Your appreciation will be passed along to Eddie, who truly values the residents he serves.

reviews.name: Regina Lembrich
reviews.body: My husband and I are extremely pleased with our new home at Avalon Station in Somerville.  I looked at other local apartments, but never felt more welcome than here at Avalon.  The transition from a large home was smooth, thanks to the assistance and support of Nancy, Brittney and Tabatha.  They are always, kind, courteous, patient, caring and professional.  They have shown special concern and consideration toward my husband who is physically disabled.  We find that the building is clean and well maintained.  The maintenance staff is friendly, efficient and responsive. Eddie has been very helpful and informative. We look forward to pleasant years ahead and send our thanks to a great staff.

response.body: It warms our hearts to hear how happy you and your husband are with your new home at Avalon Somerville Station, Regina! It’s wonderful to know that Nancy, Brittney, and Tabatha provided such exceptional care and support during your transition, especially with their attentiveness to your husband’s needs. We’re also thrilled to hear that Eddie, and the rest of the maintenance team, have been helpful and responsive, ensuring you feel comfortable and well cared for. Maintaining a clean and welcoming environment is a top priority, and it’s so rewarding to know that’s been your experience. We’re grateful to have you as part of our community and look forward to many pleasant years ahead as well!

reviews.name: Celica O
reviews.body: We have lived at the Avalon for over 2 years. The location to downtown is unbeatable and amenities (the fantastic pool) made it hard to leave, so we aren’t lol! Recently Nancy has helped us find an apartment with more space to accommodate our little guy. She explained the process of the transition so clearly we knew we made the right decision. Nancy and Brittney are the absolute best, they take time to listen and actively answer any questions we have. They always have a smile and are a true assets to the Avalon community!

response.body: Two years and counting—glad to know our community's unbeatable location and fantastic pool amenity have kept you here, Celica! Nancy and Brittney’s support in making your transition seamless is exactly what we want for residents. We'll make sure your appreciation is passed on to them, and we'll keep up the good work!

reviews.name: K Co
reviews.body: I am happy to be back in this community in 2024 after living here briefly during the construction in 2022. The south building is beautiful, and the amenities like the gym, pool, and lounge look like those shown in a luxury lifestyle magazine. All my family and friends who have visited are amazed by how beautiful this property is. Avalon has done a great job with this community; having a pool here was a nice surprise. I never would have thought back in 2022 that we'd have a pool, but seeing how beautiful it turned out, I'm impressed. The self-tour was great, and I loved taking my time to explore the property. I have to give a huge shoutout to Brittney Ramsey; her warm welcome, detailed knowledge about the community, and her sense of humor made the tour and move-in process both enjoyable and effortless.  It was truly a pleasure speaking with Brittney throughout this entire process. I also had a quick chat with Nancy during my tour; she was also super friendly and professional, and she answered all my questions with a smile. The positive vibe here made me feel so good to be back, and while I was in the lounge, Brittney was chatting with two other tenants. She was so kind to them, and they all laughed and enjoyed the conversation. Witnessing this interaction was a clear sign that I had made the right decision to move back here, and I'm so happy to live here again.

response.body: Welcome back to the community, K! We're thrilled to hear that you're enjoying your return and that the improvements, especially the beautiful amenities like the pool, gym, and lounge, have made such a positive impression. It’s wonderful to know that Brittney and Nancy provided you with such a warm and welcoming experience during your tour and move-in. We take pride in creating a friendly and inviting environment, and it’s clear that our team has done just that. Thank you for sharing your experience, and we’re so glad you’ve chosen to make Avalon Somerville Station your home again!

reviews.name: Ian Swinton
reviews.body: My experience at Avalon Somerville Station was top notch starting with my tour. Ms. Nancy Jones went above & beyond to make me feel comfortable. This is a gorgeous property  with tons of amenities. My move in date will not arrive fast enough.

response.body: Nancy will be happy to hear she made your tour a great experience, Ian! Excited for you to join the Avalon Somerville Station family and enjoy everything our community has to offer!

reviews.name: Ravi Verma
reviews.body: As were looking for rental options, Nancy Jones was a great help in guiding me and family through this process. She was always there to answer questions and made this entire process easy. Forever grateful!

response.body: Ravi, it makes our day to hear that Nancy’s guidance has made all the difference to you in your search for a new home! Glad she was able to make the process easy for you and your family!

reviews.name: Janet Narine
reviews.body: We celebrated my daughter's 35th birthday party at the Lounge on the first floor of Somerville Station Avalon South Building. Our experience exceeded our expectations.  The Lounge was airy, spacious, and immaculate. I would definitely host future events at this location and would  recommend checking this space out for your next event.

response.body: Glad to hear our lounge met your expectations and provided the perfect space for your daughter’s birthday, Janet! Appreciate the recommendation!

reviews.name: Joemon777
reviews.body: I recently moved from my family home into Avalon Station, and I am so pleased with everything.   From my first day touring, Brittney Ramsey has been an absolute pleasure to communicate with, and everything has been so simple.   The building is fantastic, and i am very pleased with my decision to move in.   The entire staff is so friendly and the building itself is excellent.

response.body: Thank you for sharing your experience, Joemon777! We’re delighted to hear that your move to Avalon Station has been smooth and enjoyable. It’s great to know that Brittney and the team have been helpful and welcoming. We’re glad you’re happy with your decision to make your home with us and we look forward to continuing to make your experience here a positive one!
